_comment: ExtensionGuard alert dispatch configuration. Copy this file and fill in your credentials.

sentinel._comment: Microsoft Sentinel - Log Analytics Workspace. Find these in Azure Portal > Log Analytics > Agents.

splunk._comment: Splunk HTTP Event Collector. Enable HEC in Splunk Web > Settings > Data Inputs > HTTP Event Collector.

pagerduty._comment: PagerDuty Events API v2. Create a service integration in PagerDuty > Services > Integrations > Events API v2.

slack._comment: Slack Incoming Webhook. Create one at https://api.slack.com/apps > Incoming Webhooks.

workspace._comment: Google Workspace / Chrome Browser Cloud Management integration. Required to push extension blocklists across a cloud-managed Chrome fleet. Install the optional dependency: pip install -e '.[workspace]'. See README 'Workspace setup' for the one-time service-account creation steps.

webhook._comment: TTP library updates from a GitHub repo. Run `extguard-webhook` (NOT the dashboard) behind HTTPS and point a GitHub push webhook at https://<host>/webhook/github with content-type application/json and the secret below. Each push STAGES the new library; review it and run `extguard-ttp-sync --activate` to make it live, unless auto_activate is true. require_verified_commit refuses unsigned head commits. The same section drives `extguard-ttp-sync`.

virustotal._comment: VirusTotal hash lookup for Stage 1d. Set api_key here OR set VT_API_KEY env var (preferred - keeps the key out of git). Free tier: 4 req/min, 500/day. Set VT_DISABLED=1 in env to globally disable VT lookups even if enabled here.
